from cache import make_key
from service import score

class Store(dict):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.calls = 0
    def __contains__(self, k):
        super().__call__(k)
        self.calls += 1
        return super().__contains__(k)

def run():
    # basic: different text recomputes
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "B", None, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2, s.calls

    # same text reuse
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 1)
    assert score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 2) == 1 and s.calls == 1

    # None profiles/criteria shared
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == b == 1 and s.calls == 1

    # changing profile recomputes
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", 1, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "A", 2, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2

    # changing criteria recomputes
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, 1, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "A", None, 2, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2

    # same profile with different text recomputes (no cross-contamination)
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "1", None, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2

    # ambiguous concatenation key: "None" string vs actual None must not collide
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, None, None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "None", None, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2, (a, b, s.calls)

    # criteria "None" vs actual None must not collide
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "X", None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "X", None, "None", lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2, (a, b, s.calls)

    # profile "None" vs None must not collide
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "X", None, 1, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "X", "None", 1, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2, (a, b, s.calls)

    # text "A" + profile None with criteria None must not collide with other combos
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "A", None, None, lambda: 1)
    b = score(s, "A|None", None, None, lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 2, (a, b, s.calls)

    # repr-based key components stay unique (spot checks)
    assert make_key(None, None, None) != make_key("None", None, None)
    assert make_key("A", None, None) != make_key("A|None", None, None)

    # changing any input invalidates only itself, reuse across repeated calls
    s = Store()
    a = score(s, "J", "p1", "c1", lambda: 1)
    assert score(s, "J", "p1", "c1", lambda: 2) == 1
    b = score(s, "J", "p1", "c2", lambda: 2)
    assert a == 1 and b == 2 and s.calls == 3

    # compute must be invoked fresh when input changes
    def make(compute):
        return score(Store(), "J", None, None, compute)
    assert make(lambda: object()) is not make(lambda: object())
    print("ALL TESTS PASSED")

run()
